role.zh: Manus（蝴蝶效应）创始人兼 CEO

why.en: From the Monica browser extension to Manus, the most prominent case of a Chinese team building a globally used AI product — and of the geopolitics that now surrounds one.
why.zh: 从 Monica 浏览器插件到 Manus，是中国团队做出全球性 AI 产品最突出的案例 —— 也是这类产品如今所处地缘政治环境的样本。

title.en: Introducing Manus
title.zh: Manus 发布

note.en: The launch that made a general-purpose agent a consumer product category.
note.zh: 这次发布把通用 Agent 变成了一个消费级产品品类。

title.en: 95. 对Manus创始人肖弘的3小时访谈：世界不是线性外推，做博弈中的重要变量
title.zh: 95. 对Manus创始人肖弘的3小时访谈：世界不是线性外推，做博弈中的重要变量

note.en: A three-hour interview with Manus founder Xiao Hong on navigating a nonlinear, game-theoretic world as an AI application founder.
note.zh: Manus创始人肖弘接受《蛋播》三小时专访，谈作为AI应用创业者如何在非线性、博弈式的世界中找到自己的位置。

note.en: A three-hour interview with Xiao Hong on building Manus, two years of AI-application entrepreneurship, and being "an important variable in the game."
note.zh: 肖弘接受《张小珺Jùn｜商业访谈录》三小时专访，谈Manus、两年AI应用创业历程及"博弈中的重要变量"。

title.en: Vol.12 张鹏对谈白鸦、肖弘、潘乱：大模型时代的产品要怎么做？
title.zh: Vol.12 张鹏对谈白鸦、肖弘、潘乱：大模型时代的产品要怎么做？

note.en: Xiao Hong joined a panel with Youzan founder Bai Ya and others, hosted by Zhang Peng, on what a real large-model-era product looks like — discussed from his experience building Monica.im.
note.zh: 肖弘与有赞创始人白鸦等嘉宾一同参加张鹏主持的对谈，结合他打造Monica.im的经验，探讨大模型时代产品应该如何做。

title.en: 插件、套壳、收购产品? Monica 从 0 到百万用户的 AI 助手之路 | 对谈 Monica 创始人肖弘
title.zh: 插件、套壳、收购产品? Monica 从 0 到百万用户的 AI 助手之路 | 对谈 Monica 创始人肖弘

note.en: In this interview, Monica founder Xiao Hong addressed accusations that Monica was a repackaged product or built on an acquisition, and explained how it grew to millions of overseas users.
note.zh: 在这次专访中，Monica创始人肖弘回应了外界关于产品套壳、靠收购起家的质疑，讲述了Monica如何做到海外数百万用户规模。

title.en: China blocks the Meta acquisition
title.zh: 中国否决 Meta 收购案

body.en: Meta announced the ~$2B deal on 30 December 2025, with Xiao expected to take a senior US role. China's NDRC vetoed it on 27 April 2026.
body.zh: Meta 于 2025 年 12 月 30 日宣布约 20 亿美元交易，肖弘原预计出任美方高级职位。国家发改委于 2026 年 4 月 27 日否决。

title.en: Butterfly Effect relocates headquarters from Beijing to Singapore
title.zh: 蝴蝶效应总部由北京迁至新加坡

body.en: Framed internally as a decision made out of necessity; later became a reference case in the debate over 'Singapore washing'.
body.zh: 内部定性为不得已的决定；后成为「新加坡洗牌」争论中的参照案例。

title.en: 20亿美元卖身Meta仅8个月，Manus又被中方资本原价"赎"回：肖弘从Meta副总裁变回独立创始人，接盘的腾讯们算的究竟是什么账

body.en: Analysis of Manus reversing a reported $2 billion Meta acquisition after eight months, with Xiao Hong reverting from Meta VP back to independent founder as Chinese capital, including Tencent, bought the company back near its original price.
body.zh: 分析指出Manus在被Meta以约20亿美元收购仅8个月后即被中方资本（包括腾讯）原价"赎回"，肖弘也由Meta副总裁重新变回独立创始人。

body.en: The Financial Times reported that exit restrictions on Xiao Hong were being lifted and that he was preparing to return to Singapore.
body.zh: 《金融时报》报道，对肖弘的出境限制即将解除，他准备返回新加坡。

body.en: The Financial Times reports that the exit restriction on Xiao Hong is being lifted and that he is preparing to return to Singapore, ending the travel ban imposed during the Manus acquisition dispute.
body.zh: 《金融时报》报道，对肖弘的出境限制即将解除，他准备返回新加坡，Manus 收购风波期间的出境禁令就此结束。
